fields.name: document_type
fields.description: Category or type of the document (e.g., Rent Agreement, Electricity Bill, Bank Statement, Cheque, Trade License, Tax Receipt, Land Record, Death Certificate)

fields.name: issuing_authority_name
fields.description: Name of the government body, bank, municipal corporation, or organization issuing the document

fields.name: issuing_office_or_branch
fields.description: Branch, division, circle, ward, or local office that issued the document

fields.name: primary_party_name
fields.description: Full name of the principal individual, consumer, licensee, assessee, account holder, or tenant

fields.name: parent_or_spouse_name
fields.description: Father, husband, or guardian name of the primary party

fields.name: account_or_consumer_number
fields.description: Bank account number, electricity consumer number, unique service code (USC), or assessee ID

fields.name: address
fields.description: Complete postal, property, or residential address stated on the document

fields.name: associated_persons
fields.description: List of witnesses, co-executants, or additional referenced parties

fields.name: official_stamp_present
fields.description: Indicates whether an official government seal, notary seal, municipal stamp, or bank stamp is affixed

fields.name: signature_present
fields.description: Indicates whether a physical signature of an officer, authority, or executant is present

fields.name: marginalia
fields.description: Handwritten notes, endorsements, or annotations found in the margins
